    In NILAID:
    (setq b #B"000000001")
    (bits-posq 1 b 7 8)
    The 'count' value 8 is out of range for ...
Yes, this is right -- starting at index 7, you can only have a 
maximum cont of 2.  that last argument is a 'count' of number of
positins to try -- not a maximum index.
